title: Sphinx Cat Composer
description: A hairless sphinx cat wearing round glasses sits at a wooden desk, intently composing music with a yellow pencil in an open notebook filled with musical notation. Behind the cat, a glowing portal in a cracked stone wall reveals a grey alien with large black eyes, while colorful melting musical notes drip down the walls and desk alongside a teacup of turquoise liquid.
